evaluation_type: LLM-judge estimates (not human labels); retrieval/citation/latency/token metrics are measured

peak_memory_mb.note: Sampled with `ps` every 0.5 s on this machine (mac-latency, local server only); null = not measured.

strict_success.note: Errors count as failures; unknown (judge invalid/unjudgeable/missing) counts as failure in the lower bound.

claim_faithfulness.rule: claims labelled not_established are not counted for abstention outputs (evaluation/judge_rules.py)

retrieval.note: Not applicable to a baseline: it has no search; the oracle is GIVEN the gold records and closed_book gets none.

citation_id.note: Cited-id set vs gold ids (source-ID match, not answer correctness). macro_*: mean over answerable trials, nothing cited = 0; precision_when_cited excludes trials that cited nothing; micro_* pools ids.

behaviour_confusion.note: Structural behaviour from terminal status vs the frozen expected behaviour; independent of the LLM judge. 'clarified' has no expected label in the benchmarks (answer|refuse), so it counts as abstention, never as a match.

errors.note: Errors count as failures in strict success; they are reported here so they cannot hide inside a quality number.

lexical_proxy.note: Lexical proxy of the agent's L1 verifier. Not semantic correctness.

judge_cost.note: Gateway-reported cost over all retained attempts (not an invoice); missing cost is unknown, not zero.

multi.note: category is task metadata; do not infer the number of gold ids from it (see gold_ids_per_task)

out_of_scope.note: category is task metadata; do not infer the number of gold ids from it (see gold_ids_per_task)

single.note: category is task metadata; do not infer the number of gold ids from it (see gold_ids_per_task)

hcmut_v1/closed_book.stratum_note: Closed-book strata are LLM estimates (config/benchmark/strata.yaml, label closed_book_probe_gemma-4-31b_llm_estimate); not human labels.

report_eligible_note: Complete main run; every trial judged, an execution error, or judge-attempted (unknowns listed in coverage and counted as failures). Still LLM-judge estimates; human audit labels pending.

paired_differences.multiple_comparisons: none applied; treat p-values as descriptive

closed_book.description: no tools, no documents (parametric knowledge only)

oracle.description: gold records (full text) given up front in the read-tool observation format; no search/read; answerable tasks only
